verses.text: So imitate God, as his dearly loved children.
Live in love, just as Christ loved us and gave himself for us as an offering and sacrifice to God, a pleasing aroma.
Among you, God's holy people, there shouldn't even be a hint of sexual immorality, impurity, or greed.
Don't use obscene language, foolish talk, or crude jokes. Instead, give thanks.
Be sure of this: no sexually immoral or impure person, and no greedy person (who is an idol worshiper), has any inheritance in the Kingdom of Christ and God.
Don't let anyone deceive you with empty arguments. These are the things that bring God's anger on those who disobey.
So don't join in with them.
Once you were darkness, but now you are light in the Lord. Live as children of light,
whose fruit is every kind of goodness, righteousness, and truth.
Find out what pleases the Lord.
Don't take part in the fruitless works of darkness. Instead, expose them.
It's shameful even to talk about the secret things people do.
But when anything is exposed by the light, it becomes visible,
because everything that becomes visible is light. That's why Scripture says, ‘Wake up, sleeper! Rise from the dead, and Christ will shine on you.’
So pay close attention to how you live—not like foolish people, but like wise people.
Make the most of every opportunity, because these are evil days.
Don't be foolish. Understand what the Lord wants.
Don't get drunk on wine, which leads to reckless living. Instead, be filled with the Spirit.
Encourage one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs. Sing and make music in your heart to the Lord.
Always give thanks to God the Father for everything, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.
Submit to one another out of reverence for Christ.
Wives, submit to your own husbands as you do to the Lord.
The husband is the head of the wife, just as Christ is the head of the church—his body, of which he is the Savior.
Just as the church submits to Christ, wives should submit to their husbands in everything.
Husbands, love your wives, just as Christ loved the church and gave himself up for her
to make her holy, cleansing her by washing with water through the word,
and to present her to himself as a glorious church, without stain, wrinkle, or anything like that, but holy and blameless.
In the same way, husbands should love their wives as their own bodies. Whoever loves his wife loves himself.
No one ever hated their own body. Instead, they feed and care for it, just as Christ does for the church,
because we are parts of his body.
Scripture says, ‘For this reason a man will leave his father and mother and be united with his wife, and the two will become one flesh.’
This mystery is profound, and I'm talking about Christ and the church.
However, each of you must love his wife as he loves himself, and the wife should respect her husband.
